Category, exact node.counted_over: all queries; the predicted node must equal the gold node (same depth; 'no category' is a value)

Category correct at L1.counted_over: queries with a gold category; predicted path has the gold L1 node

Category correct at L2.counted_over: queries whose gold category is at depth ≥ 2; predicted path has the gold L2 node

Category correct at L3.counted_over: queries whose gold category is at depth 3; predicted node is the gold L3 node

Filters precision.counted_over: predicted attribute=value pairs, pooled over all queries

Filters recall.counted_over: gold attribute=value pairs, pooled over all queries

Filters F1.counted_over: harmonic mean of the two rows above

Filter set exact match.counted_over: all queries; predicted filter set equals the gold set (incl. both empty)

Word-role accuracy.counted_over: all words of all queries; role category / filter / residual

Residual words F1.counted_over: harmonic mean of the two rows above

**Whole query exactly right**.counted_over: all queries; category exact, filter set exact, and the set of residual word positions exact

**Weighted query score**.counted_over: all queries; per query the weighted mean of category credit (0.45; partial for the right branch), filters F0.5 (0.30), residual words F2 (0.17) and the other word roles (0.08), over the parts the query involves (`sidm/score.py`); 95% interval of the mean

Latency p50 / p95.counted_over: all queries; one request each, sequential, warm model

Questions / input tokens.counted_over: server-reported input tokens (Ollama: every question charged the full prompt; mlx: tokens actually processed)
